ext_description.message: Strips hidden AI watermark characters and AI typography from your posts on X and Typefully, or from any text you paste.

btn_rich.message: Clean AI (not available for formatted posts)

power_resume.message: Turn on for X and Typefully

reply_error_NO_KEY.message: Add your Anthropic API key in Clean from AI settings

reply_error_BAD_KEY.message: Your API key was rejected. Check it in settings

reply_error_RATE_LIMIT.message: Rate limit reached. Try again in a minute

reply_error_NETWORK.message: Can't reach Anthropic. Check your connection

reply_error_REFUSAL.message: Claude declined to reply to this post

reply_error_NO_EDITOR.message: Couldn't open the reply box. Try again

reply_error_EMPTY.message: Claude returned an empty reply. Try again

opt_toggle.message: Reply with AI button on posts

opt_toggle_hint.message: Click it under any post on X: Claude writes a reply in your voice, cleans it and puts it in the reply box. You post it yourself.

opt_key_hint.message: Stored only in this browser. Create one at console.anthropic.com. A reply costs about one cent.

opt_voice_hint.message: How you write: tone, slang, emoji, length. Paste a few of your real replies, Claude copies the style.

opt_privacy.message: When you click the button, that post's text, author, images and up to 4 video frames go to Anthropic with your key. Nothing is sent otherwise.
